revision_summary: One quote-timestamp fix and one schema-labeling fix needed on rerun: (1) interest_reason_audit.reason_quote splices two non-contiguous transcript moments under a single ts of 00:36 — the 'despised solar panels' fragment is correctly at 00:36-00:41, but the widow/bills fragment is actually at 00:53-01:02. Split this into two separate quote/ts pairs or use the later ts (00:53) since that's the actual emotional disclosure being cited as the 'reason.' (2) script_coverage's 'interest_question' row incorrectly uses the 03:31 'how you doing' rapport line as evidence the verify.interest_in_solar item was 'asked' — this contradicts Stage 3's own interest_reason_audit which correctly notes asked:false. Relabel this script_coverage row to reflect that the interest question was never asked and the customer volunteered the reason unprompted at 00:53, matching the audit's own finding. Also tighten the 05:22 cherry_pick_moment reasoning: the customer self-initiates the verbal read-back of her bill graph before the rep asks about her phone — the rep does not proactively execute the elderly_low_tech_protocol pivot; credit is currently overstated. These are targeted fixes; the overall trajectory read, bill-anchor-miss framing, and handoff brief are well-grounded and should be preserved.
